name: Tunjur kingdom
alt: Tunjur sultanate of Darfur and Wadai

successors.name: Sultanate of Darfur
successors.text: Turra and the Jebel Marra, Daali's base: the Tunjur king's half-brother Daali 'usurped the kingship' in the mid-16th century

successors.name: Wadai Empire
successors.text: the Maba heartland around Wara and Abéché, where 'Abd al-Karim overthrows the Tunjur King Daud' in 1635

ledger.x: Around the 15th century: the Tunjur kingdom exists in Darfur and Wadai.
Mid-16th century: Daali takes the Jebel Marra from the last Tunjur king.
Mid-16th century: the rest of Darfur passes out of Tunjur hands.
1635: Abd al-Karim overthrows the Tunjur king.
1635: the Tunjur kingdom ends in Wadai.

wars.name: Daali's usurpation of the Tunjur kingship
wars.outcome: Daali, half-brother of Shaw Dorshid, takes the kingship; Shaw Dorshid flees to the Jebel Marra (tradition).

wars.name: Abd al-Karim's rising against the Tunjur
wars.outcome: Abd al-Karim overthrows the Tunjur king Daud and founds the Wadai sultanate.

certainty.note: No page gives a Tunjur boundary, an area or a campaign map; the shapes are the gazetteer's Darfur and Wadai regions.
